name: BN6's MegaMan's Beast chip charge
why: BN6's loadout (0x080144C0) writes +0x11 0xFF, the power attack its chip charge takes for a chip whose record +6 is 0xA in place of +5's (the chip charge's dispatcher 0x0800FB54 at 0x0800FB96, the charge time 0x08012F62 at 0x08012F8E: r7 0x11). BN4's chip charge (0x0800B72C, its flag 8) branches by his form alone (0x0800B770: form 5 0x0800D638, else 0x0800D4B4) and caches only +0xE's and +0xF's charge times (0x0800BCF4): no byte like it
